title: SC-02 owner continuation source and neighboring integration seams

interfaces.assetBrowserCallback: SpatialAssetBrowser onAdd emits sc02:<catalog-id> for new catalog entries. Classic presets retain their existing plain names. Host routes the new prefix through insertSpatialElement in canonical edit/history.
interfaces.inspector: SpatialElementInspector({entity:SpatialEntity,onChange:(element:SpatialElement)=>void}); host uses its existing CONTENT patch and preserves parent/history/selection.
interfaces.canvas: Optional playing:boolean drives effects/audio with the existing playhead. View disclosure state is transient presentation; onToggle tracks the native details open property and matchMedia opens desktop/closes narrow screens with listener cleanup.
interfaces.entity: Optional canonical entity.element; all historical checksums remain unchanged when absent. Existing entity kinds and transform graph remain authoritative.
interfaces.composition: Ordinary Scene entities and parent relationships; dependency-closed extraction and remapped insertion use the existing My Spatial Library SAVE/CAS and one Undo transaction.
interfaces.environment: SC-01 versioned Environment pin and Scene scenePresentation remain distinct from per-entity LIGHT. Preserve complete Environment content and Assistant proposal/lifecycle ownership when reconciling.
interfaces.referenceFrame: referenceSurfaceFrame(anchor,upright=false) retains legacy plane frames by default; new typed roots request a Y-up frame.

mobileSharedCssSeam.disclosure: Native summary View & audio controls; settings body is a bounded scrollable overlay while expanded. Collapsed summary stays in its row above tools.
mobileSharedCssSeam.selection: Keep Engineering coordinates/actions in one row; omit only redundant fixed-placement caption on narrow screens. Preserve adaptive quality text and live feedback.
mobileSharedCssSeam.preservedDocks: Vertical dock navigation and existing <=1099 overlay ownership remain unchanged.
mobileSharedCssSeam.integrationWarning: This one-column/seven-row seam supersedes the older two-column mobile viewport-row3 assumption. Do not layer SC-00C's former viewport grid-row3 rule onto this source without reconciling the rows.

qualification.countInterpretation: Frozen cycle4 report and packet retain the former prospective iterations4 assumption; audit qualifies it. Historical labels do not automatically set trusted review.iterations. No exception requested solely from a code ordinal.
